sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'guided', "stage" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'diagnosing', "tools_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("tools_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "draft" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "context_summary" TEXT NULL, "context_summary_up_to_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('user','assistant')), "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'complete', "error" TEXT NULL, "model" TEXT NULL, "reasoning_content" TEXT NULL, "reasoning_trace" TEXT NULL, "total_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "message_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES chat_messages (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_path" TEXT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "provider_configs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deepseek', "base_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'https://api.deepseek.com', "model" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deepseek-flash', "vision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("vision" IN (0, 1)), "supports_tools" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("supports_tools" IN (0, 1)), "thinking" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("thinking" IN (0, 1)), "supports_thinking" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("supports_thinking" IN (0, 1)), "effort" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reasoning_levels" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "preferences" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("name"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_usage_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "message_id" TEXT NULL, "provider_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "endpoint" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "feature" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "usage_source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "image_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "tool_call_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "input_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "cached_input_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "output_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "reasoning_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "total_tokens" INTEGER NULL, "cost_nano_usd" INTEGER NULL, "cost_basis" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "input_rate_nano_usd_per_million" INTEGER NULL, "cached_input_rate_nano_usd_per_million" INTEGER NULL, "output_rate_nano_usd_per_million" INTEGER NULL, "rate_source" TEXT NULL, "rate_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_model_prices" ("provider_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "endpoint" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "model" TEXT NOT NULL, "input_rate_nano_usd_per_million" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cached_input_rate_nano_usd_per_million" INTEGER NOT NULL, "output_rate_nano_usd_per_million" INTEGER NOT NULL, "off_peak_discount_percent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("provider_kind", "endpoint", "model"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "knowledge_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '个人笔记', "chapter" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "source_message_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES chat_messages (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "knowledge_revisions" ("knowledge_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "chapter" TEXT NOT NULL, "tags_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("knowledge_id", "revision"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mistakes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "question" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, "chapter" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "correct_answer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "original_answer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "own_analysis" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "ai_analysis" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "error_reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '暂未确定', "suggested_reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source_session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "source_message_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES chat_messages (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "knowledge_tags" ("knowledge_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("knowledge_id", "tag"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mistake_tags" ("mistake_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mistakes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "tag" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("mistake_id", "tag"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "knowledge_relations" ("source_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("source_id", "target_id"), CHECK (source_id <> target_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mistake_knowledge_links" ("mistake_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mistakes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "knowledge_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("mistake_id", "knowledge_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "knowledge_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "mistake_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES mistakes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES study_attachments (id), "role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'original', "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((knowledge_id IS NULL) <> (mistake_id IS NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ai_tool_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions (id), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "arguments" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "result" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_chat_links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "knowledge_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "mistake_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES mistakes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("session_id", "knowledge_id"), UNIQUE ("session_id", "mistake_id"), CHECK ((knowledge_id IS NULL) <> (mistake_id IS NULL)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learning_topics" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("name", "subject"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_questions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "stem" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, "explanation" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "hint" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "verification" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified', "absolute_tolerance" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.000001, "relative_tolerance" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "case_sensitive" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("case_sensitive" IN (0, 1)), "time_limit_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "source_session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES chat_sessions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "source_message_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES chat_messages (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "source_operation" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "mistake_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES mistakes (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "parent_question_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES practice_questions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_options" ("question_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "option_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("question_id", "option_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_answer_keys" ("question_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "answer" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("question_id", "position", "answer"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_question_topics" ("question_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "topic_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES learning_topics (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("question_id", "topic_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_question_knowledge" ("question_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "knowledge_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("question_id", "knowledge_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_attempts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', "hint_used" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hint_used" IN (0, 1)), "correct" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("correct" IN (0, 1)), "score" REAL NULL, "grading_basis" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "submitted_at" INTEGER NULL, "elapsed_milliseconds" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_responses" ("attempt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_attempts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "answer" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("attempt_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_images" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "byte_length" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_schedules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES practice_questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repetitions" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "interval_days" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ease" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 2.5, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "review_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES review_schedules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "attempt_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES practice_attempts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "event" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_due_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quality" INTEGER NULL, "independent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("independent" IN (0, 1)), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("schedule_id", "attempt_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "practice_chat_links" ("question_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_messages (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("question_id", "message_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scratchpads" ("context_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "document" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("context_key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exam_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exam_subjects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_score" REAL NULL, "scaled_score" REAL NULL, "maximum" REAL NULL, "score_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ai_reasoning" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "ai_model" TEXT NULL, "uses_scaling" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uses_scaling" IN (0, 1)), "notes" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("event_id", "subject"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exam_score_rows" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_subjects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES exam_score_rows (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "earned" REAL NULL, "maximum" REAL NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exam_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exam_subjects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_path" TEXT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subject_modules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "subject" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES subject_modules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "knowledge_module_links" ("knowledge_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "module_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subject_modules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("knowledge_id", "module_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mistake_module_links" ("mistake_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES mistakes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "module_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES subject_modules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("mistake_id", "module_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visual_scenes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scene_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "dsl_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "verification_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unverified', "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ai', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visual_scene_revisions" ("visual_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visual_scenes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scene_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("visual_id", "revision"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visual_message_links" ("visual_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visual_scenes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "message_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chat_messages (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("visual_id", "message_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visual_question_links" ("visual_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visual_scenes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "question_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES practice_questions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY ("visual_id", "question_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "visual_study_links" ("visual_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES visual_scenes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "knowledge_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES knowledge_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "mistake_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES mistakes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("visual_id", "knowledge_id", "mistake_id"), CHECK ((knowledge_id IS NULL) <> (mistake_id IS NULL)));
